objective: Feature parity across every non-gold feature event; a medal requires accepted frontend behavior, not engine capability alone.

features.name: Seekbar thumbnail previews
features.acceptance: Implementation merged in PR #23: hover-only previews use a separate paused libmpv client, a 16 MiB bounded GPU LRU cache, coalesced requests, keyboard support and accessibility. Slint hover/eligibility tests and hosted desktop, compositor, and CodSpeed checks passed. Manual desktop hover positioning and real-media preview behavior remain unverified; do not count this gap as closed yet.

features.name: Native picture in picture
features.acceptance: Implementation merged in PR #22: the View action opens a compact always-on-top window while playback continues, with Play/Pause, Return and Close controls; returning restores the prior size, position and window modes. UI and window-state tests plus hosted desktop, compositor, release-package and CodSpeed checks passed. Manual OS-specific focus, window lifecycle and multi-display behavior remain unverified; do not count this gap as closed yet.

features.name: Gapless audio playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #26 at 612a312: queued playlists, automatic advancement, queue retention on Stop, native PCM capture, and hosted virtual PulseAudio loopback are covered; loopback measured 0 ms longest internal silence across the 440 Hz→880 Hz transition. Removing the snapshot-only PlaylistPosition action improved the CodSpeed count from 34 to 26 regressed benchmarks (29 improved, 224 untouched), but the 612a312 report still flags slower load_confirmation and several common dispatch cases, so performance is not clean. Native playback controls, Windows packaging, and native helper acceptance on Linux/macOS/Windows passed. Linux and Windows Code checks passed; macOS is finishing the release build. The compositor is in progress and Desktop UI is queued. Physical listening across several track boundaries and Previous/Next remains pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: DVD / Blu-ray structure playback
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #31 at d331ad8: DVD/Blu-ray folder and ISO selection, structure/signature validation, disc-menu navigation actions, and resetting disc state for ordinary media. Desktop state/callback tests pass, a generated NTSC DVD ISO loaded through libmpv and advanced through a title, and all seven current-head CI checks passed. Packaged release playback, Blu-ray media, physical drives, and packaging/licensing review remain pending. Do not count this gap as closed or claim a medal yet.

features.name: Chromecast video output
features.acceptance: Pinned transport, restricted file serving and owned playback APIs pass real TLS/HTTP fixtures. Owner-confirmed silent H.264 playback and pause/seek/resume/stop passed on two receivers during a 30-second window. The desktop Cast menu supports manual local-address entry, bounded in-app certificate inspection, explicit pin review, opt-in bounded mDNS discovery, worker controls and loaded local media with supported audio containers. Remember/forget for up to 32 explicitly reviewed local receiver pins is implemented in local user preferences. Physical desktop UI/discovery use and audio playback remain unverified; codecs beyond tested H.264 remain unverified. No casting gold is claimed.

features.name: AirPlay video output
features.acceptance: Needs platform sender integration and receiver validation. A Samsung TV model was supplied privately; receiver-protocol support remains unverified.

features.name: AirPlay audio receiver
features.acceptance: Needs receiver networking, protocol compatibility and audio output validation.

features.name: Search and download subtitles
features.acceptance: Needs provider credentials, account/rate-limit handling and subtitle download validation.

features.name: Video-site URL playback
features.acceptance: Accepted at 8e1abde4e2785bb62495774ce6abac2c1ece57df: public desktop callbacks on all platforms, native metadata/protocol tests, live provider/decoder proof where applicable and actual compositor pixel proof. See acceptance.json for exact scope and jobs.

features.name: User extension or scripting system
features.acceptance: Executes third-party code; needs a trust, permission and lifecycle design.

features.name: Editable keyboard bindings
features.acceptance: Needs persisted user settings and cross-platform key/modifier/focus handling.

features.name: Customizable UI layout or skins
features.acceptance: Needs a layout/theme configuration model and accessibility/layout acceptance.

features.name: Touch or trackpad playback gestures
features.acceptance: The desktop video surface maps horizontal trackpad scrolling and horizontal touch drags to bounded relative seeks, and vertical scrolling/drags to volume. The software-window UI test covers 31px/32px drag thresholds, seek direction and ±15s clamps, volume 0–100 clamps, trackpad scrolling, and disabled playback state. Physical trackpad/touchscreen validation remains before acceptance; no feature medal is claimed.

features.name: System media-control integration
features.acceptance: A shared playwire adapter connects Windows SMTC, macOS Now Playing, and Linux MPRIS. The OS media session attaches as soon as the desktop engine is ready, including before a track loads; transient window readiness retries are rate-limited. Play/pause, previous/next, seek, title/artist/album, playback state, and transport capabilities use the player action path. Unit tests cover event routing, idle attachment retry policy, metadata publication, track identity, and seek behavior. The native libmpv metadata check passed in hosted Native playback controls run 45297858782. Platform session interaction and user-visible behavior remain unverified; do not count this gap as closed until that evidence is recorded.

features.name: Compact dedicated music view
features.acceptance: Needs a separate compact layout, resize/focus restoration and audio/video behavior tests.

features.name: Music playback artwork view
features.acceptance: Accepted at 8e1abde4e2785bb62495774ce6abac2c1ece57df: public desktop callbacks on all platforms, native metadata/protocol tests, live provider/decoder proof where applicable and actual compositor pixel proof. See acceptance.json for exact scope and jobs.

features.name: Automatic movie and TV library metadata
features.acceptance: Needs a metadata provider, API credentials, cache/privacy policy and library indexing.

features.name: Browse SMB network media
features.acceptance: Direct URL playback does not implement share browsing or credential storage.

features.name: Direct cloud-storage playback
features.acceptance: Needs OAuth/provider APIs and protected credential storage.

features.name: Download server media for offline viewing
features.acceptance: Needs authenticated server clients, storage quotas and cancellation/integrity handling.

features.name: Cross-device playback progress sync
features.acceptance: Needs an authenticated sync service, conflict resolution and privacy controls.

features.name: Live TV and guide frontend
features.acceptance: Needs tuner/PVR provider integration and channel/guide fixtures.

features.name: Schedule TV recordings from the player
features.acceptance: Needs scheduling, backend ownership and safe recording-file lifecycle.

features.name: HTTP remote-control interface
features.acceptance: Needs authentication, network binding and an explicit command-authorization policy.

features.name: Documented JSON IPC control
features.acceptance: Needs a documented authenticated/permissioned local control endpoint; exposing arbitrary mpv commands is not a safe default.

features.name: HD audio bitstream passthrough
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #27 at c1869a2: an explicit session-only desktop passthrough control requests AC3, EAC3, DTS, DTS-HD, and TrueHD plus exclusive output, with a control to disable it. State tests, native playback controls, and Windows release packaging passed. CodSpeed completed and reports a 13.95% aggregate improvement versus main. The video compositor and native helper checks are in progress; Code checks and Desktop UI are queued. These checks do not verify bitstream output; a compatible physical receiver/route must identify each claimed format with audible output, and decoded output must still work when passthrough is disabled. Do not close the gap or claim a medal yet.

features.name: 360-degree panoramic video
features.acceptance: Needs projection controls and visual/presentation fixtures.

features.name: Stereoscopic 3D video
features.acceptance: Needs stereoscopic output controls and display-format acceptance.

features.name: Capture playing video to a clip
features.acceptance: Needs an explicit destination/overwrite policy and recording lifecycle.

features.name: Desktop screen recording
features.acceptance: Needs OS capture permissions and capture-source selection.

features.name: Trim and rearrange video clips
features.acceptance: Needs an editing/export pipeline with synchronization and output integrity tests.

features.name: Audio conversion or transcoding
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #35 at c65d968: local-file export to WAV PCM16 or FLAC through libmpv, with source/extension validation, temporary output and no-clobber publish while playback remains independent. All eight current-head hosted checks passed, including native WAV/FLAC export acceptance and Desktop UI. CodSpeed reports no performance change. Desktop session acceptance remains pending; do not close this gap or claim a medal.

features.name: Audio CD ripping
features.acceptance: Needs drive discovery, extraction/error handling and physical media.

features.name: Audio or data CD burning
features.acceptance: Needs writing APIs and physical media; destructive recording is not a zero-risk change.

features.name: Edit media tags
features.acceptance: Writes source media; requires explicit save semantics and format-specific integrity tests.

features.name: Built-in internet-radio directory
features.acceptance: Accepted at 8e1abde4e2785bb62495774ce6abac2c1ece57df: public desktop callbacks on all platforms, native metadata/protocol tests, live provider/decoder proof where applicable and actual compositor pixel proof. See acceptance.json for exact scope and jobs.

features.name: ICC display color management
features.acceptance: Manual session RGB display-profile selection/reset accepted at c82436888a6f61c356a1125161ed7bd4df46f1f3: malformed-file bounds tests, native/public desktop controls on all platforms and twelve actual composited transform/reset trials. RGB 128→55→128 agrees with an independent Little CMS reference. Automatic per-monitor discovery/switching and physical calibration are outside this implemented control and are not claimed.

features.name: User GPU shader pipeline
features.acceptance: Accepted at 8e1abde4e2785bb62495774ce6abac2c1ece57df: public desktop callbacks on all platforms, native metadata/protocol tests, live provider/decoder proof where applicable and actual compositor pixel proof. See acceptance.json for exact scope and jobs.

features.name: Browse UPnP / DLNA media servers
features.acceptance: Needs discovery/browsing adapters, XML validation and isolated server fixtures.

features.name: Share a library as a UPnP server
features.acceptance: Introduces an inbound network service; needs permissions, discovery and access controls.

features.name: Game controller UI navigation
features.acceptance: The desktop polls standardized gilrs gamepad events and maps D-pad left/up and right/down to backward/forward focus traversal, South to activate, East/Select to back, Start to play/pause, and the left/right shoulders to previous/next. Connection and disconnection events are surfaced in the player status. Automated mapping tests and hosted platform checks pass; physical-controller hot-plug and focus-order acceptance remain pending, so no feature medal is claimed.

features.name: Browse WebDAV media shares
features.acceptance: Needs a credentialed WebDAV client, safe XML/path handling and server fixtures.

features.name: Browse NFS media shares
features.acceptance: Needs network-share discovery/mount integration and platform permission handling.

features.name: Trakt watched-history scrobbling
features.acceptance: Needs user authentication, sync conflict handling and rate limits.

features.name: Native Plex server library integration
features.acceptance: Needs authenticated library/session integration, not direct URL playback.

features.name: Native Emby server library integration
features.acceptance: Needs authenticated library/session integration, not direct URL playback.

features.name: Native Jellyfin server library integration
features.acceptance: Needs authenticated library/session integration, not direct URL playback.

features.name: Skip detected episode intros
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #29 at 84241db: bounded chapter-title seeking plus an explicit, asynchronous IntroDB lookup using embedded IMDb ID, season, and episode tags only. Provider validation, response limits, stale-result handling, and seek-boundary tests pass; all seven current-head CI checks passed. A real IntroDB response and user-visible desktop playback remain unverified. Do not close the gap or claim a medal yet.

features.name: Music visualization display
features.acceptance: Implementation is in draft PR #28 at c5b2be1. The formatter fix is on af93206; Code checks passed on Linux/macOS/Windows, Desktop UI passed on Linux/Windows, Windows release packaging and native controls passed, and the compositor plus macOS Desktop UI/native-helper jobs were running/queued at the last check. The latest completed CodSpeed report on af93206 reports 17 improved, 5 regressed, 257 untouched; the five regressions are unloaded SetSpeed dispatch at 952 ns base versus 1,118.7 ns head (-14.9%), with 22 significant comparisons flagged across different hardware. The af93206 rerun was canceled when the c5b2be1 experiment was pushed. Fresh CodSpeed and CI runs for c5b2be1 are pending. No performance improvement is claimed. Physical audio/visual acceptance remains pending; do not close the gap or claim a medal.
